name: Miraval Berkshires Resort & Spa
insider_take: This tranquil wellness sanctuary sits on 380 pristine acres in the heart of the Berkshire Mountains, where Tanglewood's summer symphony concerts have enchanted visitors since 1937 just minutes away.
whats_special: The resort's Life in Balance Spa features the region's only authentic Finnish sauna experience, while the property's organic gardens supply fresh ingredients for farm-to-table dining. The historic Berkshire region surrounding the resort was a favorite summer retreat for literary giants like Edith Wharton and Herman Melville.
pro_tip: Book spa treatments early morning or late afternoon for the most serene mountain views, and time your visit during Tanglewood's season (June-September) for world-class performances just 10 minutes away.
dont_miss: The sunrise meditation sessions on the resort's mountaintop platform offer breathtaking views of the Housatonic Valley, and nearby attractions include The Mount (Edith Wharton's estate), Mass MoCA contemporary art museum, and the charming village of Stockbridge that inspired Norman Rockwell's iconic paintings.
pros: World-class wellness programming and spa treatments
Beautiful Berkshires mountain setting with scenic nature trails
Farm-to-table dining with healthy, locally-sourced cuisine
cons: Premium pricing for specialized wellness experience
